_source.title: 创建分屏
_source.remarks.text.0: 请确认 {@link DMT_EditorControl.createSplitScreen | tabId} 对应的分屏存在两个以上的标签页，否则分屏将不会执行，并返回 `undefined`
_source.example.text.0: 1. 归一化布局：先合并既有分屏，保证两个标签页落在同一分屏
_source.example.text.1: 2. 打开两个文档，让当前分屏持有两个标签页
_source.example.text.2: 3. 把 PCB 标签页拆到一个新的水平分屏
_source.example.text.3: 4. 回读新分屏的标签页，确认 PCB 已在其中
_source.example.text.4: 5. 合并所有分屏，恢复单屏布局
_source.params.splitScreenType: 分屏类型，`horizontal` 水平、`vertical` 垂直
_source.params.tabId: 标签页 ID，该标签页将会被移入新的分屏中
_source.returns: 分屏 ID，`sourceSplitScreenId` 代表源分屏，`newSplitScreenId` 代表新分屏

title: Create Split screen
remarks.text.0: Please make sure the split screen corresponding to {@link DMT_EditorControl.createSplitScreen | tabId} has more than two tabs; otherwise the split screen will not be executed and `undefined` will be returned
params.tabId: Tab ID. This tab will be moved into the new split screen
returns: Split screen ID. `sourceSplitScreenId` represents the source split screen, and `newSplitScreenId` represents the new split screen
